dateSource: EXIF DateTimeOriginal interpreted in camera-local time, with the recorded phone offset; UTC-looking filenames are not used as local calendar dates.
locationNotes: All source photographs were reviewed in chronological contact sheets, with shortlisted frames reviewed again at larger size.
Signs, visible landmarks and capture order support place labels; GPS confirms the Montreal photographs. Exact sites are named only where supported.
Original photographs, GPS coordinates, videos and private travel records remain outside the website and R2.
The Lumineers identification is supplied by the owner and supported by the venue sign. All 96 stills from 16 February 2025 were reviewed again, including a larger 13-frame shortlist.
criteria: Choose distinct scenery, architecture, wildlife, food and daily life; retain some personal photographs for owner review.
Prefer strong frames to a fixed count. Short days and the Montreal visit have fewer suitable photographs.
Use the cover only once, separate from the galleries.
Preserve framing and colour, correct EXIF orientation, resize to 2000 pixels (2400 for the cover), and omit EXIF/XMP.

chapterCounts.location: Northern Ontario · On the way to Cochrane

omissionReasons: Near-identical bursts, duplicate copies, blurred, badly exposed, obstructed or weak frames were omitted.
Receipts, travel records, screenshots, slides and routine logistical photographs were omitted.
Videos are outside these still-photo albums.
Photographs of other Canadian trips are assigned to their own albums rather than repeated here.
Undated imports and transit photographs outside Canada were omitted.

migrationNotes: Merged all 95 existing selections from Montreal, Algonquin and Arrowhead, Moosonee and Niagara Falls; added six distinct concert photographs from the original Canada collection.
Existing WebP bytes are reused at the new album paths. Former covers become gallery photographs at their existing 2400-pixel export size, with the Arrowhead Big Bend cover used once.
The snowy Niagara visit and its Lumineers concert remain together here at the owner’s request; Toronto festival photographs remain in Daily life in Toronto.
The album title is owner-provided. Montreal remains correctly labelled as Montreal, Quebec.
Original album URLs redirect to this album. Old remote objects are retained for the existing published site until the new paths are uploaded.
